Building-only cut proxy: 32.7 m³ | maximum vertical cut: 2.14 m
INFERRED — 0.35 m below lowest occupied floor at each XY; exact linear integration on the stored TIN.
No double counting where floors overlap. This is a comparison scenario, not a contractor earthworks quantity.
Excluded: garden levelling, access stairs, working clearance, batters, individual footings, retaining walls, drainage and bulking.
Cut lines are marked on the site plan. A lower floor can sit above natural ground at its east edge.
Exploratory design — site and program gates remain open; no structural, geotechnical or sun/shadow approval.
